source: [BCF19] M. Boroumand, M. Chen, J. Fridrich, Deep Residual Network for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS 14(5), 2019, DOI 10.1109/TIFS.2018.2871749. Values from the authors' version: http://ws.binghamton.edu/fridrich/Research/SRNet.pdf, Table I (SRNet row). Still to be checked against the IEEE version of record.

protocol.images: BOSSbase 1.01 and BOWS2, 512x512, downsampled to 256x256 with MATLAB imresize, default settings
protocol.split: train 4000 BOSSbase + 10000 BOWS2 (14000 pairs), validation 1000 BOSSbase, test 5000 BOSSbase; one split
protocol.P_E: min over P_FA of 1/2 (P_FA + P_MD) on the test set
protocol.training: Adamax, 16 pairs per batch; 0.4 bpp from scratch: 400k iterations at lr 1e-3, then 100k iterations at lr 1e-4; lower rates: curriculum from the 0.4 bpp model; the snapshot with the highest validation accuracy in the final window is kept
